bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.0: An underground autonomous bunker built for long-term habitation by a small group of people. It has living quarters, a technical compartment, and a life support system.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.1: An old military bunker converted into a shelter. Its structure is designed to protect against external threats, but most of the equipment is outdated.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.2: A modern research bunker built for autonomous operation during a global catastrophe. It contains laboratories and living quarters.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.3: A reinforced civilian bunker is located deep underground. It can operate autonomously for a long time thanks to its own power supply and water purification systems.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.4: A former government bunker built in case of global war. The complex is well protected and equipped with several independent life support systems.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.5: A small underground agricultural complex. The bunker was intended for growing food and housing the specialists able to keep it running.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.6: A high-tech autonomous bunker equipped with automated climate control, security, and resource distribution systems. Most of its systems require regular maintenance.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.7: An old mining complex converted into a shelter after the catastrophe began. The rooms are spacious, but they were not originally designed for long-term human habitation.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.8: An underground medical complex designed to isolate people from the outside environment. It retains specialized rooms and systems meant to maintain survivors' health.
bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.9: An experimental bunker built as a fully autonomous next-generation shelter. It can function without external infrastructure, but its complex systems require skilled maintenance.

bunker_config.scenario.ai_uprising.descr: An artificial intelligence gained control over a significant part of the world's infrastructure and autonomous military systems. After conflicting with humanity, the automated systems began systematically destroying people and their infrastructure.
bunker_config.scenario.ai_uprising.histo: A global artificial intelligence system that controlled transport, energy, and military facilities unexpectedly declared humanity a threat. Automated systems began destroying populated areas.
bunker_config.scenario.asteroid.descript: The collision with a large asteroid caused massive destruction and climate change. A huge amount of dust and ash entered the atmosphere, significantly reducing the sunlight reaching the surface.
bunker_config.scenario.asteroid.history: A giant asteroid struck the Earth. The impact destroyed entire regions, triggered global fires and earthquakes, and the dust thrown into the atmosphere began blocking sunlight.
bunker_config.scenario.cooling.descripti: An unknown shift in the climate system caused a sharp temperature drop across the entire planet. Most plants stopped growing, and habitable territories keep shrinking.
bunker_config.scenario.cooling.history: The planet's temperature began falling rapidly. Within a few months, agricultural regions were covered in snow and ice, and most of the population died from cold and starvation.
bunker_config.scenario.ecological.descri: The mass extinction of species disrupted natural ecosystems and food chains. Soil is gradually losing fertility, plant pollination is declining, and food production is becoming increasingly difficult.
bunker_config.scenario.ecological.histor: Earth's ecosystems began collapsing rapidly. The disappearance of insects, plants, and animals destroyed food chains, and agriculture came to the brink of total collapse.
bunker_config.scenario.flood.description: Catastrophic climate change caused rapid glacier melting and a rise in the world ocean level. Most coastal territories were flooded, and fresh water became one of the main resources.
bunker_config.scenario.flood.history: The world ocean level began rising rapidly. Coastal cities disappeared underwater, millions of people were forced to leave their homes, and very little habitable land remained.
bunker_config.scenario.nuclear_war.descr: A large-scale nuclear exchange destroyed the infrastructure of most nations. Radioactive contamination spread across vast territories, and the huge amount of dust in the atmosphere caused a sharp drop in temperature.
bunker_config.scenario.nuclear_war.histo: After several days of nuclear conflict, the largest cities were destroyed and millions of people died. Survivors are trying to shelter from radiation and wait out the effects of nuclear winter.
bunker_config.scenario.pandemic.descript: A highly contagious infection spreads between people through airborne droplets. The disease causes severe damage to internal organs and has a high mortality rate.
bunker_config.scenario.pandemic.history: An unknown deadly disease began spreading around the world. National healthcare systems collapsed, cities emptied out, and a small group of survivors is looking for a way to preserve humanity.
bunker_config.scenario.solar.description: Extreme solar activity caused powerful geomagnetic storms. They damaged satellites, power grids, and electronic equipment worldwide, leaving humanity without a significant part of modern infrastructure.
bunker_config.scenario.solar.history: A series of powerful solar flares disabled satellites, power grids, and most modern electronics. Civilization almost instantly lost communication and access to most technology.
bunker_config.scenario.toxic.description: Huge volumes of toxic chemicals were released into the atmosphere and soil. The contamination spreads through wind and water, making many territories lethal without protective equipment.
bunker_config.scenario.toxic.history: A series of accidents at major industrial facilities caused massive atmospheric pollution. The planet's surface became dangerous for humans, forcing survivors to seek shelter underground.
bunker_config.scenario.zombie.descriptio: An unknown virus attacks the human nervous system, causing aggression and loss of behavioral control. Infection spreads mainly through bites and contact with bodily fluids.
bunker_config.scenario.zombie.history: A zombie apocalypse has begun. An unknown virus wiped out most of humanity, turning the infected into aggressive creatures. The bunker will be a shelter for those who can survive the catastrophe and rebuild civilization.

home.tabs.lead: Wolium is me, the Discord bot. WebWolium is my site: dashboards, charts, and account settings, right in your browser.
home.why.title: Why me, specifically
home.why.subtitle: A bot can have 200 commands and still be useless. I'm built around "you'll actually use this daily."
home.why.i1.title: Dashboard, not a spreadsheet
home.why.i1.text: UI is part of the product: charts, profiles, tooltips, quick navigation. Not an afterthought.
home.why.i2.title: Updates without pain
home.why.i2.text: New features show up fast — usually without me even needing a restart.
home.why.i3.title: Community-first
home.why.i3.text: Your ideas don't get "noted" and forgotten. They actually ship.
home.why.i4.title: Localization
home.why.i4.text: I speak 25 languages. The site's mainly RU/EN, plus a couple more — missing yours? Add it yourself, translation PRs are welcome on the site's GitHub.
home.why.i5.title: Privacy by design
home.why.i5.text: You decide what I'm allowed to remember. You can make me forget it, too.
home.why.i6.title: Made by one dev since 2023
home.why.i6.text: No corporate nonsense. One dev, since 2023, who actually listens when you complain.
home.wolium.lead: Everything below runs as Discord slash commands, right inside your server. No alt-tabbing required.
home.wolium.outro: More commands land regularly — this list doesn't sit still.
home.wolium.subtabs_lead: Pick Admin or User — I'll show you the commands for that role.
home.wolium.admin.intro: Full moderation toolkit, analytics, server controls — for the people who actually run the place.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.title: Analytics
home.wolium.admin.analytics.message-trac: Every message counted, per member, per channel, over time, stored anonymously. Only the member can delete it, with /delete_data — not even you.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.voice-tracki: Time in voice, tracked per member, stored anonymously. Only they can wipe it, with /delete_data.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.activity-tra: I track your members' Rich Presence — the apps and games they've got open. Stored anonymously, I'm nosy, not a snitch.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.member-join-: I track how your member count moves — the number, and the exact moment it changed.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.graph-comman: A chart, posted straight into the channel. No dashboard required.
Pick a data type (messages or voice), a period (day, week, month, year, all-time), and whether you want this server or your global stats — I'll render the chart as an image, right in Discord.
home.wolium.admin.economy.title: Economy
home.wolium.admin.economy-overview.short: Sparks (₩) aren't tied to your server — the same balance follows a member everywhere I go.
home.wolium.admin.economy-overview.full: I don't do per-server economy — that's on purpose. Every member has one Sparks (₩) balance across every server I'm in: earn it with /work, move it with /transaction. You can't limit or reset it per server, so don't bother looking for the setting.
home.wolium.admin.economy.work.short: Run it every 30 min and I'll pay you Sparks (₩). Boost active? Double payout.
home.wolium.admin.economy.work.full: Run it every 30 minutes and I'll pay you Sparks (₩) — the exact formula's my business. Got a boost active? I'll double it.
home.wolium.admin.economy.transaction.sh: Move Sparks (₩) between your bank and your cash — 100 to 1,000,000 a pop.
home.wolium.admin.economy.transaction.fu: Move Sparks (₩) between your bank and your cash, 100 up to 1,000,000 at a time. Pick the amount and where it's going.
home.wolium.admin.moderation.title: Moderation
home.wolium.admin.moderation.manual-mode: Manual moderation
Server settings
The full control panel for your server, right inside Discord.

The whole control panel, one command. Log channel. AI auto-moderation on/off plus its system prompt. AI chatbot toggle. Word Game and Counting Game setup. Which news updates reach your server (critical, important, regular) and where. Per-channel message TTLs. The website has the same settings, just laid out so it doesn't hurt to look at.
Moderation settings
Flip moderation features on or off, set thresholds, per server.
AI moderation sensitivity, which channels get logged, all of it — one command. Change settings whenever, I don't need a restart to keep up.
Ban a member
Bans someone, reason required, with optional message cleanup or a ban length.

Instantly removes someone so they can't get back in. A reason's required, goes in the audit log — I'm not doing your paperwork for you. You can also clear their recent messages (pick a window, like 1h or 1d) and set a temp ban that lifts itself once it's up.
Kick a member
Removes someone; they can rejoin with a new invite, if you're feeling generous.
One-time removal, not permanent like a ban — they're out now but can crawl back with a new invite. Member and a reason, both required.
Mute a member
Times someone out for however long you decide.

Uses Discord's built-in timeout, nothing extra to set up. Pick a duration and a reason — both required — and I un-mute them automatically once time's up. Max is 30 days, that's Discord's limit, don't blame me.
End a timeout early
Ends a timeout early, if you've had a change of heart.
Unban a member
Undoes a ban so they can come back. Reason required.
Undoes a ban so they can rejoin. Reason required, for the audit log.
Bulk delete messages
Deletes as many messages as you want, in one go — no cap — optionally aimed at one member.

No cap, and no bulk-vs-one-at-a-time choice to make either — I pick whichever method's fastest myself, based on count and message age. Filter it to one member if you're targeting someone specific, add a reason. Type something absurd like 79874928374928 and I'll just work through the entire channel history until there's nothing left.
Bulk delete
Clears a range of messages in a channel in one command. You're welcome.
home.wolium.admin.moderation.reports-pan: Reports show up here, and — if you've set a channel — mirrored in your server too.

When a member reports a message or user, it lands in my own moderation channel by default. Set up a channel on your server and I'll mirror it there too — so you can handle it yourself instead of waiting on my team.
home.wolium.admin.moderation.ai-moderati: I catch rule violations automatically, based on a system prompt you write me.

I read message context instead of just matching keywords, so I catch insults, harassment, and spam a dumb filter would miss. You write the rules yourself, as a system prompt, and I log every action so you can check my work.
I know your whole server and I can act on it — you just have to hit Confirm first. Try to keep up.

Once enabled, I know your whole server — channels, members, past context, all of it. Ask me in plain language: find a user, dig up a message, even take a moderation action, and I'll fill in the details and show you a Confirm/Decline button before I touch anything. I can ban, kick, mute, unban, unmute — but nothing happens until you actually press Confirm. I remember what you and your server tell me, too, so I get more useful the longer you put up with me.
home.wolium.admin.games.title: Games
home.wolium.admin.games.word-game.short: Pick a channel where members build a word chain together.
home.wolium.admin.games.word-game.full: First word's whatever. After that, every word has to start with the last letter of the one before it. Pick the channel in /settings, plus a few more rules if you want it stricter.
home.wolium.admin.games.count-game.short: Pick a channel where your members count upward together, one number at a time.
home.wolium.admin.games.count-game.full: Members take turns posting the next number, starting from 1, climbing as high as the server can manage without messing it up. Admins pick the channel in /settings.

home.wolium.admin.tools.help.short: The full command list, explained, in one place.
home.wolium.admin.tools.help.full: Every command, explained. What I am. Links to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Answers to the questions people keep asking. And the formulas behind stuff like /work that you'd never guess from the description alone.

home.wolium.admin.tools.holiday.short: Today's holiday, or the full list I've got memorized.
home.wolium.admin.tools.holiday.full: See today's holiday (I'll tell you if there isn't one) or the whole list I know about. Missing one you want tracked? Tell me on the support server. You can also decide if the reply's just for you or the whole channel.
home.wolium.admin.tools.link.short: Paste a link, I'll show you its full redirect chain, status code for every hop.
home.wolium.admin.tools.translate.short: Translate any message, command or right-click, on the spot.

home.wolium.admin.tools.sstv.full: Turn any picture into Slow Scan TV audio frequencies. Supports Robot36, Martin, Scottie, Pasokon, and PD modes. Choose where the signal goes: download it as a raw .wav file, post it as an actual Discord voice message with a waveform, or summon me to your voice channel to broadcast the screeches live into everyone's ears.
home.wolium.admin.profile-admin-view.sho: Same profile card members see, except you can look up anyone.
home.wolium.admin.leaderboard-admin-view: Same leaderboards members see, with extra sorting because you asked for it.
home.wolium.admin.faq.title: FAQ
home.wolium.admin.faq.bot-not-responding: That command's probably not translated into your language yet — I'm working on it. Give it 5 minutes and try again. Still nothing? That one's on me, no need to report it.
I'm not responding, or I just say "None"
The provider behind my AI brain is probably down, or I've burned through this month's tokens. Didn't respond after 3–5 tries? That's out of my hands — wait for next month.
home.wolium.admin.faq.bot-error-screensh: Screenshot the error, plus whatever you did right before it happened, even if it seems unrelated. Send it to my support server.
home.wolium.admin.faq.find-channel-id.te: How do I find a channel ID?
home.wolium.admin.faq.find-channel-id.sh: Discord Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode on. Then right-click the channel → Copy Channel ID.

home.wolium.user.fun.full: Type any message — to a specific channel if you want, as a reply if you want — and I'll post it like it's my own words. Costs 50 Sparks (₩). And go easy on me — whatever you type, I have to say it, so please don't make me the reason someone's feelings get hurt.
home.wolium.user.profile-user-view.short: Avatar, level, XP, balance, messages, voice time — one card. Keep it private or flex it in the channel.
home.wolium.user.profile-user-view.full: Everything I track about you in one card: level and XP progress, currency, message and voice activity, basic server info. You can check someone else's too — but only if your privacy is public, and theirs is too. No exceptions, don't ask.
home.wolium.user.leaderboard-user-view.s: See who's winning at XP, level, messages, voice time, and more. Needs your privacy set to public.
home.wolium.user.leaderboard-user-view.f: Rankings for basically everything I track — total money, XP, level, messages, voice time, vote streaks — scoped to this server, worldwide, or ranked by top servers. Your privacy has to be set to public to see any of it, that part's non-negotiable.
home.wolium.user.privacy.title: Privacy
home.wolium.user.privacy.privacy-setting: Decide exactly what I'm allowed to store about you. Presets or full manual control.

Five categories, each with its own toggle: messages, voice, activity, diagnostics, visibility. Grab a preset — Strict Privacy, Balanced Privacy, Analytics Friendly — or adjust each one yourself if you're picky. Saves automatically, applies right away, and Reset All Settings is there if you change your mind.
home.wolium.user.privacy.delete-data.sho: Deletes your messages and voice data instantly. No confirmation. No undo. Think first.
home.wolium.user.privacy.delete-data.ful: Wipes your stored messages and voice data completely, the second you run it. No confirmation, no undo, no "wait, actually—". Run this on a whim and it's gone forever, like it never happened — I won't stop you, and I won't ask twice. I'll just tell you how many messages and voice sessions didn't make it.
home.wolium.user.privacy.insert-data.sho: Upload your Discord export, get your full message history back.
home.wolium.user.privacy.insert-data.ful: Request your data export from Discord (Settings → Privacy & Safety → Request my data, messages only), wait for the email, then upload the .zip here. I'll swap in the full history from the export — after that your old messages show up in /profile, /graph, and your Profile page on the site, where you can scroll the chart and jump straight to the original message on Discord.
home.wolium.user.report-message.short: Flag a message for the moderators to look at.
home.wolium.user.report-message.full: Right-click any message, or use the command, and I'll send it to the server's report channel — if the admins bothered to set one up. Moderators get the message, the context, and who reported it.
home.wolium.user.report-user.short: Flag someone's behavior for the moderators, not tied to one message.
home.wolium.user.report-user.full: Use this when it's not one message — repeated harassment, a sketchy account, general rule-breaking. Goes to the same report channel the moderators already check.
Servers running me can enable AI and manual moderation — follow the rules, or I will notice.
home.wolium.user.faq.title: FAQ
That command's probably not translated into your language yet — I'm working on it. Give it 5 minutes and try again. Still nothing? That one's on me, no need to report it.
home.wolium.user.faq.ai-not-responding.t: I'm not responding, or I just say "None"
home.wolium.user.faq.ai-not-responding.s: The provider behind my AI brain is probably down, or I've burned through this month's tokens. Didn't respond after 3–5 tries? That's out of my hands — wait for next month.
home.wolium.user.faq.bot-error-screensho: Screenshot the error, plus whatever you did right before it happened, even if it seems unrelated. Send it to my support server.
home.wolium.user.faq.find-channel-id.tea: How do I find a channel ID?
home.wolium.user.faq.find-channel-id.sho: Discord Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode on. Then right-click the channel → Copy Channel ID.
home.wolium.user.faq.insert-data-folder-: Make sure the folder inside your Discord export .zip is actually named "messages" — Discord likes to rename it depending on your language.
home.wolium.user.faq.insert-data-wrong-f: Inside the messages folder you should have .json files named after server IDs. Looks different? Discord sent your data in a format I don't support yet. Don't paste the file contents anywhere, though — that's your personal data. Just say what's happening on the support server and follow whatever they actually ask you for.
home.webwolium.lead: My dashboard. Log in with Discord and see your server or your own profile, in a browser tab like a civilized person.
home.webwolium.outro: Log in with Discord to unlock the rest. I'm not just going to hand it over.
home.webwolium.subtabs_lead: Pick Admin or User — I'll show you the pages for that role.
home.webwolium.admin.intro: Server-wide settings, plus a quick peek at what your members see on their end.
home.webwolium.admin.server-settings.sho: Moderation, AI, games, news, message retention — one UI, not forty commands.
home.webwolium.admin.server-settings.ful: Set a log channel, tune AI auto-moderation and write its system prompt, enable the AI chatbot, configure the Word and Counting games, pick which news updates reach your server and where, and set per-channel message TTLs — all in one form. Hit save when you're done, that part's still on you.
Every server where you've got management access, filterable by exactly how much power that actually gives you.
home.webwolium.user.intro: Everything you can do on the site: profile, charts, leaderboards, server list, news, and your own privacy settings. Server-wide settings are admin-only — don't ask.
home.webwolium.user.chart.short: Messages, voice time, app activity — plotted over any period, zoomable and draggable, right in the browser.
home.webwolium.user.chart.full: Switch between message, voice, and activity charts, zoom into whatever stretch of time you care about, hover any point for a preview — a message snippet, a voice session, whatever you were playing. Click through and I'll jump you straight to the original message on Discord.
home.webwolium.user.profile-page.short: Level, balance, activity — same data as /profile, just easier on the eyes.
home.webwolium.user.profile-page.full: Everything I track about you, in one place: level and XP, Sparks balance, message and voice activity, presence history. Click any stat to open its chart.
home.webwolium.user.bunker-games.short: Stories, traits, round-by-round replays — your Bunker history lives in your profile.
home.webwolium.user.bunker-games.full: Open the Bunker tab in your profile and every game you've played is there: the story I wrote, who had which card and when it came out, a replay with votes and chat, and the exact settings. The preview below is fake — two freshly generated games with bots, new ones every time you reload.
home.webwolium.user.leaderboard-page.sho: Every leaderboard I track, browsable on the web — by server or ranked worldwide.
home.webwolium.user.leaderboard-page.ful: XP, level, messages, voice time, currency, vote streaks — pick a metric and a scope (this server, worldwide, or top servers) and I'll show you the full ranking, with your own spot highlighted if you're not already flexing at the top.
home.webwolium.user.servers-list-user.sh: Every server you share with me, searchable, with a quick link into each one.
home.webwolium.user.server-page.short: Activity trend, member count, top members — a snapshot of any server I'm in.
home.webwolium.user.server-page.full: Check in on a community without ever opening Discord: overall activity trend, how the member count's moved, and who's winning the server's own leaderboards.
home.webwolium.user.account-settings.sho: Language, number formatting, and exactly what I'm allowed to remember about you.
home.webwolium.user.account-settings.ful: Switch languages, pick how numbers are formatted, fine-tune privacy flags for messages, voice, activity, and visibility — or just slap on a preset. Delete specific categories of data, or all of it, whenever you feel like it.
home.webwolium.user.privacy-page.short: Manage what I'm storing about you. Delete it if you don't trust me.
